subject: Vendor onboarding: banking test deposits and remittance label mapping

Cc: accounts-payable@stratix.co
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Stratix banking + W-9

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intake call yesterday. Attaching the requested paperwork to start vendor setup:
- STRATIX_W9.pdf (attached)
- bank_details_stub.txt (attached) — contains routing/account stub (we can provide a bank letter if required)

We can push micro-deposits today for verification. Please confirm the amounts we should expect back (we normally send two small deposits). Once verified we can provide the ACH token/confirmation.

Also attaching our preferred remittance sample file (we can send CSV or simple text). Can you confirm Redwood's required remittance field mapping so our AP can include PO and invoice labels?

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Head of Finance Operations
Stratix Inc
elena.morris@stratix.co
Attachments: STRATIX_W9.pdf, bank_details_stub.txt

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Stratix banking + W-9

Elena — thanks, got the docs. Quick plan: 

1) Marissa / PayOps to kick off micro-deposit test today (two small deposits).
2) Once deposits clear, reply with the two amounts and we will mark the bank verified and generate the vendor ACH token.
3) We need a sample remittance string that includes: PO#, Invoice#, Net Amt, Vendor ID. Our preferred example is below. If you can match it, that will make automated reconciliation immediate.

Preferred remittance sample (single-line CSV):
"PO123456,INV-2028-789,1250.00,STRX-1002"

Marissa / Ben — please run micro-deposit for Stratix using the routing provided and confirm ETA. Ben, can you flag this as high priority since this is a scheduled customer go-live next week.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Vendor Integrations
Redwood Inference

Micro-deposits posted this morning at 10:10 PST. The two amounts are: 0.12 USD and 0.37 USD.

Attached is the receipt from our bank (micro_deposit_receipt.csv). Once you confirm those, we can accept the ACH token and begin live payouts.

Let me know if the sample remit below works or if you need additional fields.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena — confirmed, amounts 0.12 and 0.37 match what we received. Bank verified and vendor record STRX-1002 is active. ACH token generated and stored in our vault; we will share the masked token in your vendor portal.

Remittance mapping accepted. Final notes / next steps for go-live:
- Remit string format we will consume (single-line CSV): PO#,Invoice#,Amount,VendorID
- PO routing: prefix PO with the 2-letter business unit code (example: RD-PO123456) — we'll accept either plain PO or prefixed; our reconciliation rule will strip the prefix if present.
- First scheduled payout for Stratix set for 2028-11-23 (net terms agreed).

Reference artifacts:
- Drive folder with onboarding docs and bank stubs: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d-stratix-onboard
- DocuSign envelope for the vendor agreement is in flight: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?env=prod&doc=STRATIX_ONBOARD_2028

Attachments: sample_remit_string.txt (for your AP).

Thanks everyone — Jonas
Jonas Weber
